required_actions: Verify the prior handoff, original capture files, local directory object and five child cache objects before mutation.

Restage the exact five-file payload and run one dvc add; require the regenerated pointer hash, directory digest, manifest hash, file count, total bytes, and child hashes to match the prior pushed identity exactly.

Before the sole remote operation, initialize one isolated temporary DVC reconstruction repo with the tracked remote config and a mode-0600 copy of .dvc/config.local. Never print, retain in evidence, hash into public metadata, or commit credential values.

Remove/avoid any isolated local cache seed, copy only the exact regenerated pointer, then run one credential-aware dvc pull from remote object. Verify every reconstructed file hash and payload identity.

After verification, commit the exact pointer, compact summary, and necessary .gitignore metadata; run dvc status. No second push is required because the exact digest was already pushed and reconstructed.

Evict exact repository payload, original capture root, isolated reconstruction, isolated credential copy, and exact six newly retained local cache objects only after verification. Retain both compact publication handoffs and the original closed capture handoff.
forbidden: No credential output, commit, evidence inclusion, public hash, or persistence outside the mode-0600 isolated temp repo; remove that temp repo after the operation.

No dvc push, second pull/reconstruction, retry, remote mutation beyond read, evidence reinterpretation, source/runtime/config/skill/bundle changes, build/server/DB/live actions, gameplay acceptance, or ML admission.
Do not evict retained source/build/binary/prestart-bundle authorities or unrelated cache objects.
acceptance_conditions: The regenerated pointer is byte-identical to the already pushed object identity.
A credential-aware cache-empty isolated pull reconstructs all five files from remote and every hash matches.
The committed pointer/summary are exact and Git plus DVC status are clean.
Only exact verified local duplicates/cache objects are evicted, credentials are absent afterward, and the v2 handoff is canonical LF JSON.
